kilns:Brick kilns — 2 here:21.7415,87.66.name: Brick kilns — 2 here
kilns:Brick kilns — 2 here:21.7415,87.66.desc: 2 brick kilns annotated in this satellite tile. The position is the tile’s own reference point — the dataset records kilns as annotated boxes inside a satellite tile rather than as individual coordinates, so this locates them to within about a kilometre, not to a chimney. Detected from Sentinel-2 satellite imagery and hand-validated, from SentinelKilnDB — 62,671 kilns across the Indo-Gangetic Plain covering India, Pakistan, Bangladesh and Afghanistan. Brick kilns are the most consistently documented bonded-labour sector in South Asia: the mechanism is the peshgi advance, worked off across a whole family at a rate that never clears.
